description:
Approve once (granting a 15-minute single-use pass for that exact tool and price) or deny a pending sub-agent approval request. Use this with your main key after checking x402_get_account; do not use to open requests (x402_request_approval) or edit ongoing limits (x402_update_delegate_key).
Parameters: pass your main spend_key or x-atlas-spend-key header; optional note saves a short memo with your decision.
Behavior: free and final (deciding twice returns HTTP 409); an approved pass is used automatically on that single call and cannot be reused.

approval_id.description: Single-use human spend escalation approval ticket identifier returned by x402_request_approval (format: sba_<16 hex chars>, e.g. sba_aabbccddeeff0011).

decision.description: Operator decision: "approve" grants a single-use 15-minute execution pass; "deny" permanently rejects the escalation ticket.

note.description: Optional operator audit note recorded as decision_note with the approval or denial decision.

spend_key.description: Master Stripe account spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Delegated subagent keys are rejected with HTTP 403. Optional if supplied via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

name: x402_decide_approval

ok.description: True when the approval decision was recorded.

title: Approve or Deny One-Time Spend Request
